title: The Yellow Crayon with Plenty Left
youtube_title: The Yellow Crayon with Plenty Left | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a turn can make one small thing feel like enough.
summary: Juniper and Nico both need the last bright yellow crayon for a class mural, and Juniper offers a plan to share it stroke by stroke so the sun and the wheat can both be colored.
